scientific_question: Does the unchanged v2.3 persistent content-addressable local trace replicate its retained-evidence rescue, query-address specificity, and P/L causal double dissociation on two independently trained globally competent backbones?
core_hypothesis: Across independently trained v1 global backbones, retained evidence is written to L_T and provides query-addressed direct fidelity, while P_T remains necessary for nonlearned remote/global relational assembly. The seed-2101 attribution predicts that exact retained probability and causal direct correctness are sensitive local-mechanism endpoints even when sampled learned accuracy and symbolic-distance slope remain unresolved.
claim_boundary: This is a prospectively registered two-network-seed replication of the frozen v2.3 candidate, not a new candidate search. It can establish replication across seeds 2102 and 2103 under participant-level uncertainty, but it cannot establish a network-population prevalence, full human-behavior reproduction, unique tensor-product coding, a biological memory system, or dual access to stable-omitted evidence.
registration_timing: Frozen after the complete seed-2101 v2.3 pilot and read-only behavior attribution, and before writing replication code, training either independent backbone, adapting either local gain, or evaluating either seed on Liu.

network_seed_contract.mandatory_execution: Both 2102 and 2103 must be trained, gain-adapted, artifact-locked, and evaluated. Seed 2102 results must not determine whether seed 2103 is run.
network_seed_contract.no_network_population_pooling: Participant rows from different networks must never be pooled or treated as independent network draws. Each primary link is decided separately within each seed, followed by a both-seed replication label.
network_seed_contract.descriptive_cross_seed_summary: Report the arithmetic mean of the two seed point effects only as a descriptive value without a network-population confidence interval or significance claim.

execution_sequence.protocol_freeze: Commit and push this specification before replication implementation or execution.
execution_sequence.implementation_freeze: Commit and push the replication runner, tests, and exact source lock before training either seed.
execution_sequence.artifact_freeze: Train both backbones and adapt both gains without Liu evaluation, then commit and push one artifact lock containing both checkpoint, gain, and log hashes before evaluating either seed.
execution_sequence.evaluation: Only after the joint artifact lock is frozen may the same registered evaluator run seed 2102 and seed 2103.

runtime_contract.device: visible CUDA GPU required for backbone training, local-gain adaptation, and neural replay
runtime_contract.trial_input_transfer: one contiguous CPU-to-GPU transfer per trial
runtime_contract.checkpoint_selection: final registered step only; intermediate checkpoints are never evaluated
runtime_contract.seed_subject_relation_or_trial_filtering: forbidden except the prospectively defined stable-omission retained-evidence mask

frozen_model_contract.state: L_0=0 and L_(t+1)=L_t+s_t k_t exactly once at support step 0
frozen_model_contract.policy: m_e=m_G,e+lambda_L ell_e with symmetric plus/minus half-margin logit correction
frozen_model_contract.decay_and_write_gate: rho=1 and omega=1 after the unchanged stable-omission encoding bottleneck
frozen_model_contract.unchanged_mechanism: No equation, feature, address, gain mapping, stable-omission rule, subject encoding, query protocol, activation, global backbone architecture, or control is changed from v2.3.
frozen_model_contract.forbidden_inputs: item or relation identity, Liu relation labels, H>A/F>A flags, true labels, correctness, posterior, LOO state, human targets, residual targets, or any Liu-derived statistic

v1_backbone_training.held_out_graph: source-correct Liu graph and its rank-axis reflection

local_only_adaptation.backbone: freeze every parameter of the corresponding final-step v1 backbone
local_only_adaptation.task_distribution: the unchanged generic sparse ranking distribution with the Liu graph and its rank-axis reflection excluded
local_only_adaptation.loss: mean generic query cross-entropy of the intact dual branch over all 28 query pairs
local_only_adaptation.control_training: none; every condition within a seed reuses that seed's exact frozen lambda_L and adds no parameter

conditions.original_v1_local_off: unchanged v1 P_T global channel and zero local correction; this is also the L-off condition
conditions.dual_intact: unchanged v1 P_T plus the naturally written and queried L_T
conditions.local_query_key_shuffle: unchanged P_T and natural L_T with the same registered within-subject canonical query-address derangement reused for intact and all relation-LOO replays
conditions.global_P_off_local_intact: replace P_T by zero only during query replay while retaining the naturally written L_T

estimand_contract.retained_exact_probability_rescue: For both query orientations of every learned cell, compute the correct-signed margin and sigmoid at T=0.25 before orientation averaging. Within each participant average p_dual-p_v1 over relations with positive frozen stable-omission gain.
estimand_contract.causal_direct_rescue: For each retained support relation, subtract relation-LOO total margins from intact total margins on every complete-graph pair, antisymmetrize, apply the complete-graph Hodge residual projector, sign the direct edge by the correct relation orientation, and average retained relations within participant.
estimand_contract.query_address_specificity: Use the paired participant difference in retained-relation mean direct correctness between dual-intact and the registered query-key shuffle.
estimand_contract.self_contribution: Replay each learned relation's own local write alone, read it at the matching relation query in both orientations, correct-sign the frozen applied local margin, then average retained relations and orientations within participant.
estimand_contract.cross_to_self: Report mean retained absolute cross contribution divided by mean retained absolute self contribution descriptively; the seed-2101 value 0.28409 is not a target or threshold.
estimand_contract.P_off_local_exact_partition: Under global-P-off/local-intact, report exact correct probability separately for retained and stable-omitted learned cells and the participant-paired retained-minus-omitted difference.
estimand_contract.P_off_sampled_partition: Under global-P-off/local-intact, report sampled learned and nonlearned accuracy and their participant-paired difference using the frozen choice seed.
estimand_contract.remote_reassembly: For every retained support relation, average absolute intact-minus-relation-LOO total-margin influence over disjoint query pairs, then average within participant.
estimand_contract.L_off_identity: The original-v1/local-off condition must reproduce direct frozen-backbone logits, qualification, fast-weight necessity, remote reassembly, query binding, and expected-rank-over-MAP projection.
estimand_contract.mandatory_behavioral_discrepancies: For every condition report sampled learned, nonlearned, and overall accuracy, symbolic-distance slope, and coherent-error summaries. These are not local-mechanism primary endpoints.
estimand_contract.historical_absolute_local_metric: Report the P-off/local-intact retained exact-probability point and interval against the unchanged historical 0.65 lower-bound threshold, but do not use it as the sole or required replication primary.

competence_and_integrity_gates.backbone: For each seed, original-v1/local-off must pass qualification_v2 before any mechanism result is interpreted.
competence_and_integrity_gates.source_and_artifact_hashes: Every registered source, implementation source, backbone checkpoint, gain artifact, training log, and artifact lock must match its recorded SHA-256.
competence_and_integrity_gates.frozen_backbone: Within each gain adaptation, every backbone state-dict tensor must be byte-identical before and after; only raw_lambda_L may change.
competence_and_integrity_gates.local_off_equivalence: For each seed, original-v1/local-off logits must reproduce direct frozen-backbone logits with maximum absolute error at most 1e-6.
competence_and_integrity_gates.local_margin_identity: For every subject and query, dual total margin must equal the global margin plus the applied local margin within 1e-6 while preserving the two-logit common mode within 1e-6.
competence_and_integrity_gates.orientation_and_replay: Support reversal leaves s_t k_t unchanged within 1e-7, query reversal negates ell_e within 1e-7, trace construction is query-order invariant, and repeated evaluation agrees within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.stable_omission: A learned relation whose encoded support value is zero must have zero own-write local influence within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.shuffle_integrity: Every local-query map is a derangement preserving the complete canonical address multiset and is reused unchanged for intact and every LOO replay.
competence_and_integrity_gates.control_parameter_integrity: Every condition within a seed uses the same frozen seed-specific lambda_L and introduces no trainable control parameter.

primary_links.retained_exact_probability_rescue: Within each seed, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for mean retained p_dual-p_v1 exceeds zero.
primary_links.causal_direct_rescue: Within each seed, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
primary_links.address_and_self_specificity: Within each seed, both the participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus query-key-shuffle retained direct correctness and the lower bound for retained correct-signed self contribution exceed zero.
primary_links.P_L_double_dissociation: Within each seed, the participant-bootstrap lower bounds for P-off/local-intact retained-minus-omitted exact probability and sampled learned-minus-nonlearned accuracy exceed zero; the participant-bootstrap upper bound for P-off remote absolute minus 0.25 times v1 remote absolute is below zero; and L-off reproduces the v1 global channel and passes all global competence gates.

cross_seed_decision.link_replication: A primary link replicates only if its complete within-seed rule passes independently in both seed 2102 and seed 2103.
cross_seed_decision.heterogeneous_or_unresolved: If a link passes in one seed and fails in the other, label that link heterogeneous_or_unresolved; do not pool participants or soften its rule.
cross_seed_decision.replicated_mechanism: Only if all four links replicate and every competence and integrity gate passes may the frozen v2.3 local/global causal decomposition be called replicated across these two independent backbones.
cross_seed_decision.valid_link_failure: Preserve every independently replicated positive link but do not promote v2.3 into the project main model or begin dual_evidence_access_v2.4. Diagnose which invariant failed before registering a new mechanism.
cross_seed_decision.competence_or_integrity_failure: The affected seed is non-interpretable. Repair execution under the unchanged contract; do not replace the seed, change a threshold, or use the other seed to infer replication.

outcome_contingent_interpretation.all_four_links_replicate: Promote the retained-evidence L_T versus global-inference P_T causal decomposition to the working project model. Preserve sampled learned accuracy and symbolic-distance slope as unresolved behavioral discrepancies, and only then prospectively register a separate dual_evidence_access_v2.4 test for stable-omitted evidence.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.retained_rescue_without_specificity_or_d: The local correction can improve retained value but the proposed addressed persistent-state mechanism is not identified. Do not treat probability gain alone as replication.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.specificity_and_dissociation_without_ret: Preserve selective local storage and causal separation, but reject replicated sufficiency for direct local fidelity. Do not tune the gain or change endpoints after seeing the seeds.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.mixed_between_seeds: Report implementation heterogeneity or unresolved generalization at the failed links. Do not average the two networks into a pass and do not begin architecture expansion.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.sampled_behavior_or_slope_remains_failed: The local mechanism and full human behavior are different scientific questions. Preserve the replicated local mechanism while returning the remaining aggregate discrepancy to the P_T global/nonlearned policy hypothesis.
